description: Natural-log-function (អនុគមន៍លោការីតនេពែ) drills: solving simple ln equations, checking symmetry, limits at 0+ and infinity, derivative computation, concavity study, and full multi-part log curve studies (domain, limits, derivative + sign, variation, tangent line, inflection, sketch), several via an auxiliary function g(x) whose sign determines f'(x)'s sign.

source.description: Cambodian BAC II grade-12 math exercise compendium (Start Up Community), Lesson 7: អនុគមន៍លោការីតនេពែ (Natural Logarithm Functions) — exercises only, no worked solutions
source.extracted_by: manual OCR/transcription from scanned textbook (Claude Code), 2026-08-28

exercises.technique: Solve ln f(x)=k equations by exponentiating, or factor to reduce to a simpler ln equation
Check symmetry / basic monotone shape of a ln x based expression

exercises.prompt_latex: \lim(x-\ln x);\ \lim(2-x^2+\ln x);\ \lim(x^2-x\ln x+1);\ \lim(\ln^2x-\ln x);\ \lim\frac{2\ln x}x;\ \lim\frac{\ln x-x}x;\ \lim\frac{2x-\ln x}x;\ \lim\frac{3x-2\ln x}{x^2};\ \lim\frac{x^2-\ln x+1}{x^2+2}\ \text{(each at }x\to0^+\text{ and }x\to+\infty\text{)}
exercises.technique: Compute limits at 0+ and +infinity, comparing growth rates of x^n vs ln x
Prove a given asymptote by showing lim[f(x)-line]=0, using lim x^{-k}\ln x=0
Compute the derivative of ln-based functions using (\ln u)'=u'/u, product/quotient rule, or study concavity via f''(x)

exercises.prompt_latex: f(x)=(\ln x)/x^2+2;\ f(x)=1+x-\ln x;\ f(x)=4x-\tfrac12x^2-2;\ f(x)=2x^2-4\ln x+3;\ f(x)=2\ln x+4/x-5;\ \text{prove even/odd for}\ f(x)=x+\ln x-1,x^2+2\ln x-3,2-\ln x-x,1+1/x-\ln x,2\ln x-2/x+1,2\ln x+\tfrac23x^3-1,x-x^2+2\ln x,1/x+\ln x-2x,x^2/2-2/x-\ln x,x+\ln(x+1),2x-\ln(x-1),2\ln x-(x^2-2)/x
exercises.technique: Compute derivative and classify monotone behavior of combined polynomial/log expressions

Full log-function study (BAC-II style, ~4-6 parts each): domain, limits at 0+/infinity (using lim x^{-k}\ln x=0), asymptote proof, derivative via an auxiliary function g(x) whose sign is studied first (since f'(x)=g(x)/x^2 pattern is common), variation table, tangent line, inflection point, sketch of curve C
Find domain and classify shape of log-of-rational-function expressions ln[(ax+b)/(cx+d)]
Past BAC II exam log-function problems and full studies comparing curve C to an auxiliary parabola P via g(x)=f(x)-P(x)
